textwithimage.text:
Single Board Computer (SBC) based on TQMLS102AL

This single board computer is based on the CPU module TQMLS1012A. The Layerscape processor LS1012A combines the 64Bit ARM core architecture with the QorIQ high-speed communication technology. This platform is suitable for various applications such as networks, industrial automation, IoT gateways and controllers and meets the requirements for reliable, fast and secure data processing. The 2x Mini PCIe platform can be extended to use wireless solutions based on UMTS/GPRS, WiFi and LoRa Wan.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Cortex® A53-based on LS1012A
  • Packet Acceleration Engine
  • Low power consumption (typ. 1-2 W)
  • High-speed communication via 2x Gigabit Ethernet, 1x PCle, 1x USB 3.0 and 1x SATA 3.0 interface
  • Extended temperature range
  • QorIQ Trust Architecture and Arm® TrustZone

MBLS1012AL-AA

MBLS1012AL-AA ,TQMLS1012A, Cortex®-A53/800 MHz, 64 MB Q-SPI NOR Flash, 512 MB DDR3L, 64-kB EEPROM, -25°C - +70°C, 2x USB 3.0, 5x ETH 10/100/1000, 2x Mini PCIe (1x only USB, SIM-Card), 1x SATA M.2, USB – Debug Interface, JTAG RTC, Temperature sensor, Reset-Button, SD-Card interface
Starterkit STKLS102x set

The MBLS1012AL set is delivered with the TQMLS1012AL module with a Cortex®-A53 CPU from NXP. The components contained in the single board computer constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of this platform in your own designs. For this platform, there is also a housing solution available to enable use as a complete system.
MBLS1012AL-AA

TQMLS1012AL-AA with Encryption Cortex A53 / 1000 MHz, 64MB NOR Flash, 512 MB DDR3L, 64kB EEPROM, RTC

5x ETH 10/100,1000 (4x via Switch)

2x Mini PCIe (1x only USB / 1x SIM Card )

USB –Debug Interface, Reset-Button, Status LED

SD-Card interface -25°C - +70°C
Other configurations on request
